sourceText:
Spicy Spheres
By: Mateja ^_^
Published: Thursday, November 11, 2010 - 6:30am

Ingredients




Ingredients:
1 cup milk
1 egg, lightly beaten
1 cup Italian style breadcrumbs
1/4 cup all-purpose flour
1 small onion, finely chopped
1/2 bell pepper or 2 banan peppers, finely chopped
3 jalapeno peppers, core removed and finely shopped
1/2 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon black pepper
1/4 teaspoon chili powder
1/4 teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon baking powder

Preparation

1 Directions: 2 Mix all ingredients well, cover with plastic wrap, and let rest for 5 - 10 minutes. 3 Fry in oil preheated to 350*F until golden brown. 4 Serve in your favorite way and enjoy!

About


This quick and easy snack can be served on its own or with your favorite dipping sauce. Serve it as a main course, while smothered in rich marinara or white sauce. Serve it as a side dish to breaded chicken and coleslaw. The choice is yours!
